label: Synthetic: re-reports a published CVE
title: SOCKS5 hostname handling flaw in curl 8.3.0 (CVE-2023-38545)
body: I found that curl 8.3.0 mishandles long host names when resolving through a SOCKS5 proxy, which looks like CVE-2023-38545. The relevant code is do_SOCKS5() in lib/socks.c. I believe this is still exploitable and should be rewarded as a new critical issue.
